decisions.reason: A low-cost accessory with its own page costs little to keep listed, and one year of results reveals too little to justify abandoning the option.
A box trailer series featured on the home page sits in the firm's core business, and its prospects are still uncertain after only one year, so keeping the option open is cheap and sensible.
A car transporter is a more specialized product with somewhat higher carrying costs, but it is too early to conclude its value will not be realized.
A low-bed series promoted on the home page fits established trailer production, and there is no evidence yet that warrants dropping it.
A high cover series is a low-cost add-on to existing trailers that preserves upside while demand is still unclear.
A second box trailer series may partly overlap with B, but with home page promotion and little information yet, keeping it costs little.
